nodes.label: Farmer-led research and innovation

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable agricultural practices|Farmer-led research and innovation_qna_000
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: Who are some of the researchers cited in the paper related to the topic of producer agency and food futures?
nodes.answer: Researchers cited in the paper include Carolan, Comi, Higgins et al., Legun and Burch, and Van der Velden et al.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable agricultural practices|Farmer-led research and innovation_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: Who were the participants involved in the dialogues for the study?
nodes.answer: The participants were three female researchers and two female regenerative farmers in Denmark.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable agricultural practices|Farmer-led research and innovation_qna_002
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What is the main focus of the research described in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The main focus is on creating dialogues with farmers to involve them in analyzing their own situations and thoughts while addressing the power imbalances in research processes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable agricultural practices|Farmer-led research and innovation_qna_003
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What role do farmers play in the research process described?
nodes.answer: Farmers participate in analyzing their own situation and thoughts, contributing to the dialogues established in the research.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable agricultural practices|Farmer-led research and innovation_qna_004
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What sections follow the introduction of the research methods in the study?
nodes.answer: The sections that follow the introduction of the research methods are Results, which includes a literature review, an analysis of a desk study concerning Dutch sugar beet cultivation, and a detailed analysis of seven empirical case studies.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable agricultural practices|Farmer-led research and innovation_qna_005
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are the three parts of the study mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The three parts consist of an exploratory literature review, a desk study on sugar-beet cultivation, and analysis of in-depth interviews with initiators of seven empirical case studies.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable agricultural practices|Farmer-led research and innovation_qna_006
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What methodology was used for the structured review conducted in 2021-2022?
nodes.answer: The methodology was informed by the PRISMA guidelines and the framework for systematic literature reviews in agricultural sciences proposed by Koutsos et al. (2019).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable agricultural practices|Farmer-led research and innovation_qna_007
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What institutions contributed to the research mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Lule University of Technology, Vattenfall Research & Development AB, and the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences contributed to the research.
